title: The Plurinational State: the Constitution of 2009
goal: Describe the Bolivian Constitution of 2009 and the Plurinational State, using por más que for concession.
grammar: concessive clauses with por más que + subjunctive

items: I can grant a point and still state my main idea with *por más que* + subjunctive.
I can say what the Constitution of 2009 recognises and where it was promulgated.
I can name the main words for the constitution, the assembly and the wiphala.
